request.question: 是否允许本轮验证通过后创建对应 Draft PR，并运行 GitHub CI？这可能消耗 GitHub Actions 额度；不包含合并或发布。

limits: After successful current formal checks and own local closeout, create exactly one corresponding Draft PR after exact head/duplicate/material checks; actual CI may consume GitHub Actions quota. No merge/close/delete/release.
